project.name: Importer — OpenAPI / Swagger
project.description:
Turns an OpenAPI 3 or Swagger 2 document into draft scenarios.
The document a team already publishes is the one source that describes every operation an API has, so it is the fastest way from "we have an API" to "we have a draft test". What it does not describe is which of those operations matter, in what mix, or what data they need — so this importer produces a draft plus findings and never a finished test.
It reads operations, methods, paths, parameters and request bodies, and preserves operationId (CLAUDE.md §23). It uses example, default and enum values the document itself states, and where a value is required and the document states none, it says so rather than inventing one: a made-up identifier produces a test that exercises validation-failure paths at scale and reports them as latency.
Depends on platform-domain, plus Jackson for reading the document. Jackson is deliberate: the domain stays free of serialization types (a rule from Increment 1B), an importer is an adapter and adapters may hold their format library, and Jackson — databind and the YAML dataformat — is already a dependency of platform-api and platform-core, so nothing new enters the build. Neither Spring, persistence, engine nor Kubernetes types are permitted here, and ModuleDependencyRulesTest enforces that.
